scope: Local pinned API2 source and local manuals only; no API/algorithm motion or configuration calls

sources.python_manual: /home/tongji/aloha/shadow_rm_robot/docs/睿尔曼机械臂接口函数说明(Python)V1.5.pdf

units.evidence: rm_position_t (ctypes line 1420), rm_euler_t (1460), rm_pose_t (1500), rm_current_arm_state_t (1823), to_dictionary (1845). API2 structs/arrays contain floats already in these units.

work_frame.semantics: Currently selected work coordinate system; pose is work frame relative to controller base.
evidence: API2 C rm_set_manual_work_frame comment: new work pose relative to base
Python manual PDF page 60, section 5.8.2; page 62 section 5.9.1

tool_frame.semantics: Currently selected tool coordinate system; pose is tool endpoint relative to robot flange center. It is not automatically the actual grasp-center TCP.
evidence: Python manual PDF page 56 section 5.6.6 and page 58 section 5.7.1

current_arm_state_pose.verified: API2 returns current end pose values in m/rad, unaltered except output rounding in Python to_dictionary.
current_arm_state_pose.unresolved: The inspected local current-state function/struct and manual section do not explicitly say whether the reported pose is default-end in base/world or current-tool in current-work. Do not infer this binding from the active frame names.
evidence: API2 C rm_current_arm_state_t pose field (rm_define.h line 251): current pose only
current_arm_state_pose.limitation: If work/tool offsets are zero, static numeric agreement cannot distinguish the two frame interpretations. Do not change a controller frame to investigate under this authorization.

end2tool.input: Default-end pose expressed in controller world/base frame (API2 uses wording world coordinate system + default tool).
end2tool.output: Current tool endpoint pose expressed in current work frame.

tool2end.input: Current tool endpoint pose expressed in current work frame.
tool2end.output: Default-end pose expressed in controller world/base frame (API2 wording: world coordinate system + default tool).

terminology.note: API2 calls the fixed reference 'world'; the older manual calls it 'base'. No shared physical lab-world identity is inferred. These definitions establish transform semantics, not robot installation or camera calibration.

canonical_policy: Keep ee_pose.reference_frame and target_frame null with UNKNOWN status; separately save active work/tool names and all raw SDK return values. Never set a calibration confirmation flag from SDK presence or connection success.
